digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities framework (Bedrock native structured output)
propositions: native_structured_output is blanket-disabled for all Claude via _REBAR_OVERRIDES family default, but E1 measured native structured output working under extended thinking on specific Bedrock cells (sonnet-4-6 and haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0).

native_output_with_thinking field exists on ModelCapabilities but is silently dropped on all three construction paths (_capabilities_from_profile, string-fallback, _intersect_capabilities) because they omit the field from their dicts and constructor calls, causing overrides setting native_output_with_thinking: True to be inert.

Per-cell override rows exist in _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES but the measured Bedrock cells lack rows setting native_structured_output: True and native_output_with_thinking: True scoped to their exact measured ids and account/region.

FallbackModel chains that intersect capabilities from multiple candidates collapse native_output_with_thinking to False because _intersect_capabilities lacks an all() intersection line for this field, routing native-output chains under thinking to PromptedOutput instead of NativeOutput.

Unit tests must verify the plumbing is not inert: native_output_with_thinking set in an override row must reach the constructed ModelCapabilities on all three paths (profile, string-fallback, intersection), and measured cells must resolve to NativeOutput under thinking while opus and unknown ids remain PromptedOutput.
